request.style: English, solo female voice, warm and resonant, acoustic guitar, fiddle, banjo, upright bass, handclaps, joyful and majestic, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
All you peoples come near
Clap your hands in the air
Shout to God with cries of joy
Let the noise ring out loud

[Chorus]
The LORD Most High is to be feared
A great King over all the earth
He subdues peoples under us
Nations beneath our feet

[Verse]
He chooses our inheritance for us
The pride of Jacob whom he loves
Selah rests upon the land
We stand in His command

[Chorus]
The LORD Most High is to be feared
A great King over all the earth
He subdues peoples under us
Nations beneath our feet

[Bridge]
Joy fills the hearts of the nations
Fear and awe in our hearts
The King rules over everything
With power and with love

[Chorus]
The LORD Most High is to be feared
A great King over all the earth
He subdues peoples under us
Nations beneath our feet

[Outro]
Pride of Jacob whom he loves
Great King over all the earth
